📖 How to use

  1. Press “New game” to shake the board — the 3:00 timer starts.
  2. Click adjacent letters to build a word (Q counts as Qu).
  3. Press “Submit word” — valid new words score by length.
  4. Find as many as you can before time runs out.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as a valid word?

Words must be at least 3 letters, formed by chaining adjacent letters (including diagonals) without reusing a cube, and must be in the 5,200-word dictionary. The Q cube counts as “Qu”.

How is scoring calculated?

3–4 letters = 1 point, 5 = 2, 6 = 3, 7 = 5, 8+ = 11. Longer words are where the big scores hide.

Are the dice real?

The board uses the 16 official Boggle dice with their real letter distributions, shuffled and rolled fresh every game.
